text:
Hiro (People Ops): Quick Q from Sana  she mixed personal sightseeing on the first and last day of a week-long client trip in Berlin. How do we handle per-diem vs actuals and exchange rates when days are split?

Sana (Engineering): I worked Mon-Thu, stayed Fri-Sat for a friends wedding, but I used the same hotel for the whole week and paid one folio. I also lost one taxi receipt. I booked with personal card because company card was declined.

Olga (Finance): Policy: split days are pro-rated. Business days get per-diem or actuals (if you submit receipts and choose actuals). Personal days are non-reimbursable except business portion of shared costs (e.g., hotel room if manager pre-approved sharing).

Hiro (People Ops): Do we allow splitting a single hotel folio between business/personal nights? What's the process?

Olga (Finance): Yes. Provide the hotel folio plus a short allocation explaining which nights were business vs personal (dates). Add supporting calendar invites and client meeting confirmations for the business nights. We'll split the invoice proportionally by nights. If room rate varied by night (weekend vs weekday), list nightly rates or show folio line items.

Sana (Engineering): Lost taxi receipt  I have Google Maps timeline + card statement showing the charge. Acceptable?

Olga (Finance): Acceptable. For lost receipts: card statement + a short attestation explaining the merchant/date/time works. For cash without proof, we need a manager attestation.

Hiro (People Ops): What about exchange rates? The hotel charged in EUR and the card statement shows USD amount. Should they convert receipts to USD or leave as original?

Olga (Finance): Keep original currency on receipts. In the expense system enter the original amounts and attach the card statement which shows the bank conversion. If paying cash or if bank conversion not available, use ECB/XE rate for the date of transaction and note the source. travel-bot: see travel policy - foreign currency handling.

Sana (Engineering): Any approvals needed because I used personal card? Manager approved the week before but not the personal-card usage.

Hiro (People Ops): Manager approval covers the trip, but Finance prefers a line in the expense saying "company card attempted but failed, manager approved reimbursement on personal card". If personal-card usage is frequent, we'll remind about company card use.

Olga (Finance): Also note: if the non-reimbursable personal portion is > 50% of the total lodging cost, People Ops review is required. For mixed trips, code as: "Travel > Lodging - split business/personal" and attach allocation.

Sana (Engineering): Thanks. I'll upload folio, calendar invites, card statement, Google Maps timeline, and add the allocation note.

Hiro (People Ops): Perfect  that should clear it. Closing once Finance confirms reimbursement. :white_check_mark:
